resources.string: Choose how ingredients are checked. Your choice applies right away.
Fast and offline. Matches ingredients against the built-in allergen list.
Offline. Uses the downloaded model to check each ingredient.
Checks the whole ingredient list with a chat model you choose.
Scores each ingredient and flags those at or above your threshold.

Cloud ingredient detection sends extracted ingredients, one allergen per request. The optional food-type cross-check sends the front photo to the image-capable model below, including when ingredient detection runs on device. Save before using either cloud feature.
Stored on this device only and never backed up.
Format: provider/model, as shown on OpenRouter.
Lower values flag more ingredients for review. Default: 0.5.
Higher is faster but may hit rate limits. Default: 1.
Unsaved allergen changes will be saved too
Add your API key and save to start using cloud detection.
Enter a model ID in provider/model format.
